ideas.title: Investigation into the Use of Force by Federal Agents
ideas.description: An investigation into the use of force by federal agents in the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti and other incidents
ideas.angle: Excessive use of force by federal agents
questions: What are the protocols in place for federal agents to use force?
How often do federal agents use force in the line of duty?
searches: use of force by federal agents
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a pattern of behavior by federal agents that could be putting the public at risk. By investigating the use of force by federal agents, we may be able to identify systemic issues that need to be addressed.
